gaps.sentence: The coach criticised the team's lack of ___ (DISCIPLINE).
gaps.explanation: 'Lack of discipline' — the noun is required after 'lack of'.

gaps.sentence: The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
The ___ (DECIDE) to close the factory was announced yesterday.
He was ___ (COURAGE) enough to speak first.
She showed great ___ (WISE) in avoiding the deal.
gaps.explanation: 'Wisdom' — the quality noun from wise (spelling: wise → wisdom).

gaps.sentence: The team celebrated a quick ___ (SOLVE) to the crisis.
gaps.explanation: 'A solution to the crisis' — the noun.

gaps.sentence: The bridge is an ___ (IMPRESS) piece of engineering.
gaps.explanation: The bridge impresses people: it is impressive.
